token.description: The value of the environment variable the node's `token_env` names.

info.description: Scores one search query against its candidate passages. A worker runs wherever a suitable accelerator is; Mash reaches it with `[reranking] backend = "remote"`. Bodies are versioned binary frames with little-endian integers. Generated from crates/mash-search/src/semantic/remote_reranker/worker.rs; do not edit.
info.title: mash-reranking-worker

post.description: One attempt per search pass: the client never retries, and reranks on its own CPU when the worker does not answer within its time bound. A frame with an empty query and no documents is a warm-up and runs no inference. The worker refuses a recipe other than its own, so its scores are interchangeable with the client's CPU scores.

parameters.description: Present when the body is a zstd-compressed frame. Clients compress frames of one kilobyte or more. The decompressed frame has the same byte limit as a plain one.
parameters.name: Content-Encoding

requestBody.description: Request frame, in order: the 4-byte magic `MRK1`; u16 recipe length and the recipe as UTF-8; a 32-byte request ID chosen by the client; u32 query length and the query as UTF-8; u32 document count; then for each document a u32 ID, a u32 length and the text as UTF-8. Document IDs are unique and cover 0 to count-1. Nothing follows the last document.

200.description: Reply frame, in order: the 4-byte magic `MRR1`; the request's 32-byte ID; u32 inference time in milliseconds; u32 score count; then for each document a u32 ID and an f32 raw logit. There is one finite score per document, within the stated magnitude. A warm-up reply has no scores.

400.description: The frame is malformed, exceeds a query or document byte limit, or names another recipe. The message says which and never contains input text.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or wrong.

413.description: The body exceeds the byte limit.

415.description: The content encoding is not zstd.

500.description: The model failed or produced a score outside the contract.

post.summary: Score a query against its documents, or warm the worker up
